The ideal candidate will have a strong background in **Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)** and **Order Management System (OMS)** implementations, preferably with experience in **Blue Yonder (BY) WMS** and **IBM Distributed Order Management (DOM)** platforms.

* Gather and document functional and technical requirements and user stories for WMS and OMS implementations, enhancements, and integrations.
* Collaborate with business teams, solution architects, vendors, and internal IT teams in requirement gathering, design, development, testing, go\-live, and hypercare project phases.
* Provide technical and functional leadership on platforms such as Blue Yonder WMS and IBM DOM.
* Ensure successful system integrations with e\-commerce platforms, transportation management systems, and global logistics partners.
* Support hypercare and production operations, ensuring system stability and timely issue resolution.
* Develop and maintain project documentation, including requirements, test plans, deployment guides, and training materials.
* Stay current with emerging logistics technologies and industry best practices.

 **Communication:** Facilitate effective communication between offshore and onshore teams, ensuring requirements and use cases are understood.

 **Soft Skills:**

* + Exceptional team management skills, with the ability to bridge geographically dispersed teams.
	+ Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address operational challenges and drive strategic outcomes.
	+ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business/IT stakeholders and vendors
	+ Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities, and adapting to changing business needs.

 **Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of IT Business Analyst or IT Product Owner experience with at least 3 years in logistics or supply chain technology roles.
* 3\+ years working in Agile sAFE delivery methodology with JIRA
* Agile sAFE Product Owner and/oor Product Manager certification (preferred)
* Proven experience in functional and technical user story creation and interface mapping
* Proven experience in authoring detailed acceptance criteria associated with functional and technical user stories.
* Proven experience in implementing and supporting WMS and OMS solutions in complex environments.
* Solid understanding of warehouse operations, DTC fulfillment, and global logistics processes.
* Experience working with Blue Yonder (BY) WMS and IBM DOM (preferred), and Oracle ERP (preferred).

* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience in designing, building, and maintaining distributed systems or back\-end infrastructure.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience in information retrieval, search relevance, data indexing, or knowledge graphs
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



The Enterprise Knowledge Platform (EKP) powers Google’s internal search engine and intranet. Our mission is to organize Google's internal knowledge and make it instantly accessible to all Googlers. We build the core infrastructure, knowledge graphs, and search capabilities that employees rely on daily to find code, documents, and tools.  

  

In this role, you will address large\-scale engineering challenges, leading to the design of highly scalable distributed systems and optimizing search relevance. You will accelerate productivity and innovation across all of Google.


The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and deploy scalable back\-end infrastructure and search ranking models for Google's internal search engine.
* Lead the architecture of complex distributed systems, optimizing for performance, indexing speed, and high availability.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional partners (product manager, UX, and other engineering teams) to define product strategy and technical roadmaps.
* Provide technical leadership by driving engineering best practices, conducting design reviews, and mentoring junior engineers.
* Build and scale Google's internal search engine. Address complex distributed systems challenges and enhance search relevance, directly empowering Googlers worldwide to instantly find the information, code, and tools they need. Shape the core infrastructure of Google's internal knowledge ecosystem, driving productivity and innovation across the entire company.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

**Job Description:**

**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.  

  

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.  

  

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.  

  

Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.  

  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.


Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.


In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

**Process Overview\***


Business Finance and Control (BFC) sits within the CFO Org and is mainly responsible to ensure strong financial controls along with enabling the business. The Global Rates (GR) BFC supports the GR business, which falls under Global Markets and specifically in the Global Market FICC division. Counterparty Portfolio Management (CPM) BFC desk manages 2 individual VTDs that are engaged in trading, risk management and optimization activity across asset classes in Global Markets. VTDs include:

* XVA End\-User and XVA Flow (collectively, XVA) are responsible for pricing and hedging credit and funding risks on OTC derivatives executed with Global Markets clients (CVA and FVA)
* Risk Optimization Group (ROG) is primarily responsible for maximizing the efficiency of compressions of OTC derivatives between affiliates and CCPs

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got to you so fast? Did you ever think about where this package came from and how much it cost to deliver?  

  

Join us in leading the revolution of Amazon's transportation network as we build real\-time, intelligent, and fully automated systems that optimize package delivery across the world's most complex logistics network. As Amazon expands globally, you will lead teams whose work directly impacts millions of customers worldwide, sets new standards for online shopping experience, and drives innovation in the transportation industry through intelligent automation and AI\-driven solutions.  

  

In this leadership role, you'll guide teams tackling complex problems involving design and implementation of highly scalable distributed systems, optimization of data storage systems, and Big Data analytics. You'll strategize and drive the development of next\-generation automation systems, leading intelligent solutions for automated code and network configuration generation, hands\-free troubleshooting, and sophisticated impact analysis tools. Your organization will be responsible for building self\-healing infrastructure and automated deep dive capabilities that quickly identify root causes across vast amounts of operational data.  

  

We're seeking an experienced technical leader and software development manager with a proven track record in leading teams building highly\-scalable, cloud\-based distributed services with millisecond latency requirements. You should have deep expertise in Service Oriented Architecture, microservices, and both relational and non\-relational databases. Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams, driving technical strategy, and delivering large\-scale projects is essential.  

  

You'll thrive in this role if you excel at building and leading high\-performing teams, breaking down complex problems into simple, elegant solutions, and effectively communicating technical vision to diverse audiences. We value leaders who can build strong engineering culture, develop talent, and implement best practices around quality and security.

* Build and lead a team of software engineers, setting technical direction and maintaining high standards of engineering excellence
* Mentor and develop engineers through career growth and technical advancement
* Manage team resources, hiring, and organizational planning
* Drive engineering excellence through process improvements, architecture reviews, and technical leadership

* Partner with product, program management, and other engineering teams to define and execute technical roadmaps

* Participate in on\-call rotation as part of standard engineering responsibilities
* Operate in an agile environment, prioritizing high\-impact work while maintaining exceptional reliability standards

  

About the team  

We are the Amazon Shipment Optimization organization. Our vision is to build a real\-time, intelligent, and intuitive "hands off the wheel" fully automated system to model Amazon's complex transportation network. This network processes millions of requests per second to determine guaranteed delivery dates and optimal transportation paths, managing billions of attributes including warehouses, routes, time windows, and costs. Our Transportation Optimization systems make critical decisions that impact billions of dollars annually, setting new standards for online shopping experience. * Experience partnering with product or program management teams

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Chatbot for ERP Data
jobs.description:
Amotion AI builds AI products for large enterprises. Our client for which we are hiring is building a product \- an AI chatbot that lets SAP users ask business questions in plain English and get accurate answers from their own data — no SQL knowledge needed, no data analyst required.
 



  





 The product is live, processing real queries in production. It converts plain\-English questions into database queries, verifies the results before showing them, and achieves 99\.5% query execution accuracy across 354 tested business scenarios. We are hiring a Technical PM to help scale it and build the product further based on market demand and requirements.
 



  





**The role** 




 You sit between product strategy and engineering. Your job is to take what the product needs to do and turn it into clear, detailed requirements that engineers can build from. You then track that work through to delivery.
 



  





**What you will own** 



* Writing detailed product requirements — user stories, API specs, acceptance criteria — for the core AI query engine, the business language layer, and enterprise customer integrations
* Managing the active backlog, setting sprint priorities, and coordinating releases across product phases
* Collecting and structuring requirements from paying enterprise customers across the Middle East and Southeast Asia
* Working with engineering on the accuracy testing system — how the chatbot's query performance is measured, tracked, and improved over time
* Coordinating security certification work (SOC 2, ISO 27001\) into the product roadmap



  





**What we need from you** 



* 5\+ years in product management, with at least 2 years as a Technical PM on a B2B SaaS product
* Ability to write specs engineers build from directly — data models, API definitions, edge cases, error conditions
* Comfortable reading code, database schemas, and system design documents without needing them translated
* Experience running a technical backlog with a structured prioritization system
* Direct customer\-facing PM experience — discovery calls, requirement gathering, managing conflicting inputs from multiple stakeholders



  





**Good to have** 



* Background in data, analytics, BI, or developer tools (Snowflake, dbt, PowerBI, Databricks, or similar)
* Familiarity with AI products built on large language models, especially tools that generate SQL or code from natural language
* Working knowledge of SAP and other ERPs
* Exposure to enterprise deployment requirements such as role\-based access controls, audit logging, or fully offline (air\-gapped) environments

* Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, and implement solutions based on current and future state architectures and reference models

Utilizes strong understanding of the business vision to offer guidance and influence the business owner's requirements. May provide overall leadership to Product Owner team through mentorship and guidance.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
 Applies scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes strong business knowledge, influence and communication skills to anticipate problems, address them accordingly while working cross functionally in a self\-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. jobs.description:
TJX Companies
   

  

 At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.
   

  

****Job Description:****
 The TJX Companies, the leading off\-price apparel and home fashions retailer in the U.S. and the world is looking for a
 **Staff Product Owner (Workday)** 
 to join our Human Capital Management (HCM) Solution Delivery team which is responsible for software and systems that support TJX’s world\-class Global Human Resources and Payroll organizations. This role will guide the team that designs, configures, and delivers the Global Workday Human Capital Management solution.
   

  

****Job Description****
**What you’ll need**
 Our team thrives on strong relationships with our business partners and working to address their needs which support TJX strategic initiative and growth.  Our goal is to align IT delivery with business strategy.  We seek a motivated and talented Staff Product Owner to help guide the team supporting the Global Workday Human Capital Management solution.
   

  

**Ideal candidate:** 
 A collaborative and strategic Staff Product Owner with strong Workday HCM expertise who excels at translating complex HR business needs into clear, value\-driven solutions within an Agile framework. Proven ability to partner across business, product, and engineering teams to deliver scalable, compliant global HCM capabilities while managing priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations effectively.
   

  

****Minimum Qualifications****
* 3 \+ years of experience as a Product Owner in an HCM environment supporting large complex project/product implementations, working directly with business owners to identify and prioritize their needs.
* Proven knowledge of agile methodology, scrum, SAFe, and agile tools (JIRA/Confluence).
* Practiced consultative partnership with customers, with the ability to translate functional needs into requirements that drive value
* Experience in defining/prioritizing a team backlog of user stories including acceptance criteria.
* Experience analyzing cross functional business processes and defining integrated user stories using industry standard techniques.
* Ability to manage dependencies and shifting priorities in and across sprints /PIs.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, tailoring to all audiences.
* HCM Workday experience required
* Excellent critical thinking skills and demonstrated ability to proactively manage stakeholder expectations.
* Experience working as part of an Agile Release Train and participating in ART and Scrum Team Ceremonies.
* Good knowledge of business analysis, project management, and product management concepts are desired, along with an understanding of how enterprise software products are positioned and developed.
* Ability to coordinate work with Product Manager, Product Analysts and Engineers.
* Partner with Product Managers to align on HCM initiatives with product strategy, roadmap priorities, and business outcomes, ensuring dependencies with downstream Workday modules are clearly understood and planned.
* Work closely with Product Analysts to gather, refine, and document business and functional requirements, translating complex HR processes into clear specifications for configuration and development.
* Collaborate with engineering throughout the design and delivery lifecycle to ensure functional requirements are technically feasible, well understood, and implemented according to Workday best practices.
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent IT Delivery skillset / training / experience


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Product Owner / Product Manager Certification (POPM) preferred

* Experience working in multi\-country environments, with awareness of data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and Works Council requirements.

* Familiarity with Workday hierarchies (e.g., supervisory orgs, cost centers, location hierarchies).
* Ability to create custom reports to support business processes and operational needs.
* Demonstrated experience in knowledge sharing, documentation, and training delivery

**Company Description** 
 Eli Lilly and Company is a global medicines company focused on turning cutting\-edge science into therapies that improve lives around the world. Founded nearly 150 years ago by Colonel Eli Lilly, the company is driven by the vision to continuously enhance and advance its innovations: “Take what you find here and make it better and better.” Leveraging biotechnology, chemistry, and genetic medicine, Lilly’s scientists work urgently to address some of the most significant health challenges facing society today. The organization emphasizes responsible engagement with its communities and provides clear guidelines for interactions, while offering dedicated support channels for questions about its medicines.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Owner role at Eli Lilly and Company in Hyderabad is a full\-time, on\-site position responsible for end\-to\-end ownership of a defined business, product, or process area. This includes setting strategic direction, defining objectives, and translating them into actionable plans that align with company priorities. The Owner will coordinate day\-to\-day operations, monitor performance metrics, and drive continuous improvement across cross\-functional teams such as R\&D, manufacturing, quality, finance, and commercial. The role involves managing stakeholder expectations, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and relevant industry regulations. The Owner will also be accountable for preparing business reviews, reporting progress to leadership, and fostering a culture of collaboration, transparency, and scientific and operational excellence.
   

**Qualifications**
* Proven ability to lead and own a business, product, or process area, including strategy setting, roadmap development, and execution oversight.
* Strong skills in project and program management, including planning, prioritization, risk management, and performance tracking.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with scientific, technical, operational, and commercial teams in a complex or regulated environment.
* Solid analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make evidence\-based decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present clearly to senior leadership.
* Background in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, or a related field is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences, engineering, or a related discipline; advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD, or equivalent) is a plus.
* Demonstrated commitment to ethical conduct, quality, and compliance with industry standards and company policies.
* Ability to work on\-site in Hyderabad and collaborate effectively with global and local teams across time zones.

jobs.title: Founder's Associate
jobs.description:
Building a physical consumer brand is chaotic. I’m hiring someone who thrives in it.
 



  





 We are looking for a full\-time Founder’s Associate to join us at KORI, a brand\-new functional beverage brand based in Hyderabad.
 



  





 If you want a front\-row seat to building a physical consumer brand from zero to one, and are willing to get your hands dirty to make it happen, read on.
 



  





**What is KORI?** 




 KORI is a new\-age functional beverage brand built for real life. We believe that if wellness feels inconvenient or tastes bad, most people won’t stick to it. So, we create bold, potent, and premium wellness beverages designed to fit seamlessly into modern, fast\-paced routines. No giant juices, no added sugar, and no fluff. Just clean, functional momentum.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 As a Founder’s Associate, you are my co\-pilot. You will be helping me run the business directly. One day you’ll be closing B2B deals with cafe owners in Jubilee Hills, the next day you’ll be at our manufacturing plant troubleshooting a production run, and the day after that, you’ll be running a pop\-up tasting event.
 



  





**You will drive:** 




 • B2B Growth: Hitting the streets to pitch and onboard independent cafes, gyms, and wellness clinics.
 



 • Operations \& Supply Chain: Coordinating with our factory, managing inventory, and ensuring our deliveries are seamless.
 



 • Marketing \& Community: Running weekend pop\-ups, talking to customers, and gathering real\-time product feedback.
 



 • Dynamic Problem Solving: Navigating and solving whatever unpredictable challenges arise during the early stages of a startup.
 



  





**Who You Are:** 




 • A relentless executor: You don’t wait for instructions. You see a problem, you find a solution.
 



 • A brilliant communicator: You can confidently pitch a business owner, negotiate with a supplier, and hype up a customer.
 



 • Highly organized: You love spreadsheets, tracking pipelines, and bringing order to fast\-moving environments.
 



 • Aesthetic sense: You have a great eye for design and brand presentation. Any hands\-on design experience (even if you’re just a Canva whizz) is a huge plus.
 



 • Based in Hyderabad: Having reliable transportation to conduct local B2B client visits and manage events across the city is a big plus.
 



 • Experience: I care way more about your drive, adaptability, and common sense than your specific degree.
 



  





**What’s in it for you?** 




 You will learn exactly how to build, manufacture, market, and scale a CPG brand in India. This is a crash course in entrepreneurship. As the company scales, high performers will have a clear, fast\-tracked path into senior leadership roles across our future operations and growth teams.
 



  





**How to Apply:** 




 Send me a message on LinkedIn or an email to hello@drinkkori.com with your resume and a pitch answering this:
 



  





*If I handed you a cooler with 50 bottles of KORI tomorrow morning and said, “Get these stocked in 3 new cafes in Hyderabad by 5 PM,” what is your exact game plan?* 




  





 Let’s build something massive!

Job Description**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description:**


The Senior Data Acquisition Analyst is responsible for coordinating setup and management of external and non\-CRF clinical data integrations including central labs, imaging, IRT, eCOA, wearable devices, and API\-based integrations. This role supports end\-to\-end external data acquisition activities, vendor coordination, reconciliation processes, and study readiness while ensuring compliance with organizational standards and regulatory requirements.


This role collaborates with Data Delivery Leads, Database Design teams, vendors, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, and study teams to deliver scalable, standardized, and analytics\-ready external data solutions.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate setup and management of non\-CRF data integrations including central labs, IRT, imaging, wearable devices, and eCOA systems.
* Own assigned integrations end\-to\-end, ensuring successful delivery and alignment with business and study requirements.
* Drive standardization of integration approaches and downstream data consumption awareness.
* Develop and maintain vendor data transfer specifications, mapping documentation, and reconciliation requirements.
* Partner with vendors and cross\-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of external datasets.
* Review incoming vendor data for formatting, mapping, quality, and reconciliation discrepancies.
* Support API\-based integrations and external data transfer processes where applicable.
* Contribute to vendor oversight and execution of reconciliation activities for external data sources.
* Perform reconciliation activities between vendor datasets and CRF/EDC data.
* Collaborate with Database Design teams to align external data integrations with study database structures and standards.
* Troubleshoot vendor integration, data ingestion, and external data flow issues.
* Support study milestone planning and readiness activities related to external data delivery.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, quality tracking records, and integration deliverables.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance data integration efficiency.

**Accountabilities:**

* Support timely and accurate acquisition and integration of non\-CRF and external datasets.
* Assist with development and maintenance of vendor data transfer specifications and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders to support study timelines and database readiness.
* Maintain operational efficiency, inspection readiness, and adherence to data acquisition standards and processes.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, computer science, health sciences, or related discipline and 5\-8 yrs Experience.
* Experience in clinical data management, vendor data integration, or clinical operations.
* Working knowledge of EDC systems, data transfer processes, and reconciliation activities.
* Familiarity with non\-CRF data sources such as labs, imaging, eCOA, IRT, or wearable data.
* Understanding of GCP, clinical trial workflows, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 5–7 years of experience in clinical data management, vendor data integration, or clinical operations.
* Experience collaborating with vendors and global study teams.
* Exposure to API integrations and external clinical data flows.

 Amazon Physical Stores is more start\-up than big\-company, a group of entrepreneurial, analytical, and creative leaders with innovation at our core. We’re pushing the state of the art in helping customers shop in engaging, fast, and safe ways. To date we’ve created stores that let you use an app to enter, take what you want from our fresh selection, and go (Amazon Go); a smart shopping cart that uses computer vision algorithms and sensor fusion to let you skip the checkout line (Amazon Dash Cart); and contactless services that let you pay, enter or identify yourself (Amazon One). Note: The specific team is internally and tech focused to delivery scalable solutions.
   

  

 Our checkout\-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a cart. When you’re done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Check it out at amazon.com/go. Designed and custom\-built by Amazonians, our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earths’ most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware design.
   

  

 We are looking for a Business Analyst with a passion for using data to discover and solve real world problems. You will enjoy working with one of the richest data sets in the world, latest technology, and the ability to see your insights drive the creation of JWO stores.
   

  

 The perfect candidate will have passion and experience analyzing data and using that analysis to drive key insights and recommendations. As a business analyst you will also build reports and metrics, drive ad hoc analysis and communicate insights to key stakeholders. You will not only execute on the required skills but also be able to influence, educate, and drive results in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self\-service support for customers
   

  

 Interface with business customers, gathering requirements and delivering complete reporting solutions
   

  

 Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from a wide variety of data sources
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 This position will closely work with CXQO operations team to develop dashboards to analyze data for determining root cause, building business insights and dive deep.
   

  

 It involves complex analysis and diving deep into key metrics based on requests, building and maintaining multiple databases.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We have BIEs and DEs in our team to support analytics,data and reporting needs for DS, SDE and PMs across JWO team

* 3\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 5\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience with SQL


**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.description:
***Product Manager – Research Compliance***

  


Sitero is a technology\-enabled clinical research organization (CRO) and eClinical solutions provider dedicated to accelerating drug development for pharmaceutical manufacturers, emerging biotechs, and medical device companies. Our integrated platform combines expert regulatory consulting, end\-to\-end clinical trial management, and purpose\-built eClinical technology — including electronic data capture (EDC), electronic Trial Master File (eTMF), clinical trial management systems (CTMS), RTSM, Patient Payments, eConsent, pharmacovigilance, quality management, and SiteroAI — all in a single, sponsor\-centric business model.

  


The Product Management function is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and guiding product initiatives across the company’s product portfolio. Product Managers work across multiple products, business areas, and stakeholder groups to ensure product investments are aligned with company strategy, customer needs, market opportunities, regulatory expectations, operational goals, and delivery capacity.



This role serves as a key connection point between customers, commercial teams, operations, engineering, quality, implementation, support, and leadership. Product Management is accountable for translating business problems and customer needs into clear product direction, actionable requirements, prioritized roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  


Product Managers may support a variety of solutions across the organization, including clinical trial, operational, reporting, compliance, research administration, and research compliance products. For research compliance solutions such as eCompliance, this may include workflows related to IRB, IACUC, IBC/biosafety, Conflict of Interest, grants, committee management, protocol submissions, reviews, approvals, amendments, renewals, reporting, audit trails, and institutional oversight.

Digital.ai is the only AI\-powered software delivery platform purpose\-built for the enterprise, enabling the world's largest organizations to build, test, secure, and deliver high\-quality software. By unifying AI\-driven insights, automation, and security across the software development lifecycle, Digital.ai empowers enterprises to deliver innovation with confidence. Additional information about Digital.ai can be found at digital.ai and on Twitter, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

We are hiring a Channel Sales Specialist to own and grow Digital.ai's global channel sales motion for our Testing product line. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role that blends strategic partner development with hands\-on execution. You will be the engine behind our testing partner ecosystem — activating and deepening relationships with global and regional Systems Integrators (SIs) who have established testing practices, recruiting new SI and reseller partners, and co\-selling to accelerate revenue at scale.



Testing is one of the fastest\-growing segments in enterprise software delivery, and SIs sit at the center of that growth. * **Manage Channel Conflict:** Define and maintain clear rules of engagement between direct and indirect teams. Resolve channel conflict quickly and fairly to protect partner trust.

* **End\-to\-End Enablement:** Deliver a structured enablement program for each partner: sales training, technical certification, competitive positioning for testing, and services alignment. Ensure every active SI partner can sell and implement Digital.ai Testing independently.

At SolarWinds, we’re a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
 


  
 
 Senior Product Manager \- Intelligent Events, Health, and SLOs
 



  

**Role Summary:** 




 This Senior Product Manager will own the strategy for how SolarWinds defines, measures, and communicates the reliability and operational health of customer systems.  The core focus is transforming raw observability data into actionable, intelligent events and proactive health scores, directly enabling customer Service Level Objective (SLO) management and incident reduction.  This role drives the product vision for event correlation and anomaly detection, ensuring our platform moves customers from reactive monitoring to proactive incident prevention.  Success will be measured by the adoption of SLO features, the reduction in alert volume for customers, and the quality of system health scoring.
 



  

**Core Responsibilities:** 




 Define the product strategy and roadmap for Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs), ensuring seamless configuration, tracking, and reporting for our enterprise users.  Lead the development of the event management platform, focusing on advanced correlation, root cause analysis, and proprietary noise reduction techniques to combat alert fatigue.  Establish a unified, platform\-wide health and risk scoring model that synthesizes metrics, logs, and traces into a single, understandable view of system wellness.  Collaborate with machine learning and engineering teams to integrate AI\-driven anomaly detection and predictive alerting features for the proactive identification of impending issues.  Must be the voice of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) persona, translating industry best practices into powerful, simple\-to\-use product features.
 



  

**Required Qualifications:** 




 Deep domain expertise in AIOps, event management, and Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, with specific experience in defining and launching SLO/SLI features.  Proven experience in product managing technical platforms that leverage data science, machine learning, or statistical models for event correlation and anomaly detection.  Strong working knowledge of how observability data (metrics, logs, traces) is used to calculate system health and drive automated workflows.  Must possess impeccable oral and written communications skills, exceptional leadership capabilities to drive cross\-functional alignment, and proven expertise in product strategy and product management fundamentals.  Demonstrated ability to deliver features that fundamentally improve a customer’s operational efficiency and reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).

Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Our PMs are empowered to make the right decisions and we encourage a culture of celebrating failures that enable us to take appropriate risks in the process. We are now looking to build the support for onboarding merchants on various storefront platforms such as Shopify, Woocommerce, Magento, etc. We want to build the easiest, fastest, most\-intuitive experience for integrating with these platforms, among other things.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first\-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights \- both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long\-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data\-driven, and test \& iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long\-term view. Ensures value\-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high\-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go\-to\-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.

**About CodeRabbit**
 CodeRabbit is an innovative research and development company focused on building extraordinarily productive human\-machine collaboration systems. Our primary goal is to create the next generation of Gen AI\-driven code reviewers: a symbiotic partnership between humans and advanced algorithms that significantly outperforms individual engineers. We combine language models with human ingenuity to push the boundaries of software development efficiency and quality.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring an AI\-native Product Manager to own CodeRabbit's local experiences: the CLI, IDE and editor integrations, plugins, and the skills that let developers shape how CodeRabbit works. This is where CodeRabbit shows up inside the developer's own loop, in the terminal and the editor, and increasingly inside the agents they code with. This is a high\-ownership IC role with a clear path to build and lead a team once you've settled in and proven impact.
   

  

 This is the most cutting\-edge surface we have. The ground moves monthly as the agentic coding ecosystem evolves, and we want a PM who's already living there: someone who uses these tools every day, has written their own skills, understands how agents actually call tools, and has strong instincts for where developer workflows are heading next.
   

  

 If you're AI\-pilled in the most practical sense, you don't just have opinions about agents, you build with them, this is your role.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
**CLI \& Local Review**
* Own the CodeRabbit CLI end to end: the experience of running reviews locally, before a PR ever opens, as a fast and natural part of the local dev loop
* Drive the pre\-commit and pre\-merge story so developers catch issues at the point of writing, not after
* Define what "instant, in\-flow feedback" looks like and relentlessly cut the latency and friction that gets in its way


**IDE \& Editor Integrations**
* Own the VS Code extension and the broader set of editor integrations (JetBrains, Cursor, and wherever developers actually write code)
* Surface findings, explanations, and one\-click fixes inline, where the code lives, rather than forcing a context switch
* Decide which editors and surfaces to invest in based on where our developers and the market are moving


**MCP \& Agent Workflows**
* Make CodeRabbit a first\-class participant in agentic coding loops: a tool that agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and others reach for as part of how they write and ship code
* Own the MCP integration and the design of how CodeRabbit exposes itself to agents, with the taste to get the tool surface right
* Anticipate where agent\-driven development is going and make sure CodeRabbit is built into that workflow, not bolted onto it


**Skills \& Extensibility**
* Own the skills and extensibility experience: how developers and organizations encode the way they want CodeRabbit to review, beyond our defaults
* Design the authoring experience for skills from the ground up, informed by having written and shipped skills yourself and understanding exactly how they work
* Build the foundation that turns CodeRabbit from a fixed reviewer into a platform people can shape to their own standards and stack


**Who You Are**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company
* AI\-pilled in practice: you use agentic coding tools every day, you've written your own skills, you understand MCP and how agents call tools, and you stay on the cutting edge of the AI dev ecosystem because you genuinely enjoy it
* Technically fluent. You can read and write code, you're at home in a terminal and an editor, and you can have detailed conversations with engineers without a translator
* You ship fast and iterate in the open, comfortable building in a space where the right answer changes month to month
* Comfortable with ambiguity; can move from fuzzy problem to clear spec without hand\-holding
* You write well and communicate precisely. PRDs and tickets you've written are things you're proud of
* Low ego, high ownership. You care about the outcome more than the credit


**Nice to Have**
* You've shipped CLI tools, IDE or editor extensions, or developer SDKs
* You've built or contributed to MCP servers, agent integrations, or agent\-native tooling
* You've published skills, plugins, or open\-source developer tools that people actually use
* You're active in the AI dev community and have a point of view on where agentic development is heading
* Prior experience at a developer tooling, DevOps, or code intelligence company


**What This Isn't**
 This isn't a stable, well\-specced roadmap you'll execute for a year. The surfaces you own change as fast as the AI dev ecosystem does, and a big part of the job is having the taste and conviction to make bets before the answer is obvious. If you need certainty and a fixed brief, this probably isn't your best fit right now.
   

  

 What it is: the most forward\-looking, highest\-upside product bet we're making, the place where CodeRabbit meets developers and their agents head\-on. We need someone who's excited to live on that edge.
   

  

**Who You'll Work With**
 You'll partner closely with our engineering leads (frontend, backend, SRE), the head of design, and our developer\-facing and growth teams. You'll report into Product leadership and work alongside a tight\-knit, high\-output India engineering team that moves fast and expects the same from product.
   

  

****Our Values****
* 🤝 Collaborative Humans: Prioritizing collective intelligence
* 🚀 Fearless Innovators: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities
* 💪 Persistent, Passionate Developers: Thriving on complex, long\-term challenges
* 🎯 Impact\-Driven Creators: Crafting intuitive tools for developers
* 🧠 Rapid Learners and Un\-learners: Adapting quickly in our fast\-paced technological world

**Job Summary**


We are seeking an experienced **Senior ServiceNow Developer – Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)** to lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise\-grade SPM solutions on the ServiceNow platform. This role will focus on **Demand Management, Project \& Portfolio Management (PPM), Agile Development, Resource Management, and financial governance**, enabling data\-driven decision\-making and strategic alignment.

	+ Performance Analytics and Reporting
	+ Integrations and data transformations
* Experience supporting **Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models** in ServiceNow.

**Soft Skills \& Leadership**

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfortable leading discussions with senior stakeholders and executives.
* Experience facilitating SCRUM ceremonies and portfolio governance forums.

 **Why Join Us?**

* Lead **enterprise\-level SPM transformations** that drive strategic outcomes.
* Work on cutting\-edge ServiceNow capabilities and future roadmap initiatives.
* Collaborate with a forward\-thinking, high\-impact team.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, leadership growth, and ServiceNow certifications.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.description:
**About Us**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.


Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win.

 **About Team**


Roundel is Target’s entry into the media business with an impact of $1\.5B\+; an advertising sell\-side business built on the principles of first\-party (people\-based) data, brand\-safe content environments, and proof that our marketing programs drive business results for our clients. We are here to drive business growth for our clients and redefine “value” in the industry by solving core industry challenges vs. copy current industry methods of operation. Roundel is a key growth initiative for Target and leads the industry to a better way of operating within the media marketplace. Target Tech is on a mission to offer the systems, tools, and support that our clients, guests, and team members need and deserve. We drive industry\-leading technologies in support of every angle of the business, and help ensure that Target operates smoothly, securely, and reliably from the inside out.

 **Role Overview** As a **Senior Engineer****(AdTech)**, you will serve as the senior engineer for core engineering team and subject matter expert for our AdTech platform. You will operate as an individual contributor and take technical \+ component owner in an agile environment, helping in designing key components and support architectural improvements for complex solutions. The key to the success of this position is possessing deep domain expertise in distributed systems, a mastery of AdTech protocols(a plus), and the ability to influence engineering decisions. You will collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering leads to deliver AdTech capabilities including SSP, DSP and Ad Servers, ensuring our systems are highly scalable, low\-latency, and fault\-tolerant.


Use your skills, experience, and talents to be a part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals.

 **Technical Leadership \& Architecture**

* **System Design:** Design high\-throughput, low\-latency systems capable of handling millions of transactions per second (TPS) required for Ad serving.
* **Driv****e Architecture:** Drive the end\-to\-end technical architecture for critical AdTech components, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and future scalability alongside Engineering lead
* **Code Quality \& Mentorship:** Act as a bar\-raiser for code quality; perform advanced code reviews, mentor engineers, and foster a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
* **Technology Strategy:** Contribute in evaluating and select appropriate tech stacks (Language, Database, Cloud Native services) to solve specific business problems; drive "build vs. buy" decisions alongside Engineering lead
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Data Science and Product teams to translate complex business requirements into robust technical specifications and architectural blueprints.
* **Operational Excellence:** Drive resolution of the most complex technology roadblocks, including deep\-dive debugging of distributed systems, infrastructure bottlenecks, and latency issues.
* **Innovation:** Stay current with AdTech industry trends (e.g., Privacy Sandbox, OpenRTB updates) and advocate for the adoption of new technologies and design patterns that give Roundel a competitive edge.
 **Requirements**

* **Education:** 4\-year degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience.
* **Experience:** 6\+ years of software development experience with at least 3\+ years in a senior engineer role
* **Core Stack:** Expert\-level proficiency in Java17\+, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture, Kafka, Redis, Caching solutions, Monitoring \& Deployment
* **Big Data \& Streaming:** Deep experience with Kafka, datapipeline or similar streaming/batch processing frameworks.
* **AdTech Domain:** Proven experience in AdTech/MarTech (DSP, SSP, Ad Exchanges) with a deep understanding of OpenRTB standards, VAST/VPAID, and identity resolution.
* **Database:** Experience with high\-performance NoSQL databases (e.g., Cassandra, ScyllaDB, DynamoDB, Aerospike) and caching layers (Redis, Memcached).
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Hands\-on experience with Cloud platforms (GCP preferred, or AWS/Azure) and Kubernetes/Docker.
* **Architecture:** Demonstrated ability to design distributed systems with strict SLA requirements (sub\-millisecond latency).
 **Desired Qualifications**

* Active contributor to the Open Source community.
* Strong experience in handling large scale \& low latency production systems.
* Strong experience in Adtech systems is a plus.
* Familiarity with Data Privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA) and their impact on system design.

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

Join us as Head of Data Science


* Join our senior leadership team in Data Science \& Innovation (DS\&I) within Data \& Analytics
* Create what’s next by developing new data products, leveraging the bank’s data assets, while shaping how the bank works by helping embed data\-driven thinking and ways of working

**What you'll do**
------------------


As Head of Data Science, you’ll solve the most complex business problems, driving 6x ROI using data science methods and tools, while leveraging a team of data scientists and engineers. You’ll be the Product Owner of the bank\-wide data science platform and tools, driving adoption and usage, including these platforms across India, as well as the Chief Digital and Information Office, and business teams. Alongside this, you’ll lead and grow the bank’s Data Science Community of Practice and ensure a steady flow of data talent into the bank.


You’ll own and drive a leading\-edge data research agenda, developing new intellectual property and publishing peer\-reviewed papers. You’ll lead the India team of DS\&I data scientists and engineers to explore and demonstrate how new techniques can be applied to data. We'll look to you to create value across the business through transformational projects, while delivering prioritised use cases and working closely with stakeholders. Moreover, you’ll create academic and industry networks to support our influence, acting as the bank’s technical data science expert in India at industry forums and conferences as required.


In addition, you’ll be:


* Leading the India\-focused education, selling and embedding developments in data science across the bank
* Leading the India Data Science Community Of Practice, driving the identification and delivery of opportunities to support the bank’s strategic direction through better use of data
* Acting as the pastoral lead for all DS\&I resources in India
* Leading the Indian data science research and experimentation agenda to deepen the bank’s understanding of leading\-edge analytical techniques, technologies, and tools
* Building the bank’s brand in global data science communities to drive a constant inflow of new talent into the bank

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------


We’re looking for someone with deep experience of deploying data science techniques in industry, including the pragmatic implementation of AI solutions such as machine learning and generative AI, to drive transformational value. You’ll bring the ability to work with and influence business stakeholders and data science peers alike, using a combination of technical expertise and storytelling skills where appropriate.


To succeed in this role, you’ll need a broad and deep understanding of banking across all franchises and functions, from both a business and data perspective.


In addition, you’ll need:


* Experience deploying advanced data techniques including Python, Spark, and the AWS\-stack such as SageMaker and ECS, across structured and unstructured data environments
* Strong team management and development skills in a technically complex environment
* To be a structured thinker with the ability to clarify and simplify complex ideas with ease
* A PhD in Data Science or related area and at least 10 years industry experience

**Welcome to our Bangalore hub**
--------------------------------


Located at Taurus 4, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, our new office stands as a state\-of\-the\-art hub for innovation and collaboration.

* A 30 acre campus
* Space for 6,000 colleagues

**Dyson IT**
 At Dyson, we demand the highest performance standards from the technologies we engineer. Our people expect the same from the technology that supports them.
   

  

 Global IT plays a critical role in enabling Dyson’s engineering teams to deliver world class innovation through scalable, reliable, and forward\-thinking digital platforms.
   

  

**Our RDD IT Team**
 The RDD IT function has end\-to\-end accountability for the design, delivery, and support of the systems that enable Dyson’s global research, engineering, and product development communities.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Engineering platforms such as PLM (Teamcenter), CAE, simulation, and digital engineering tooling
* Global product development systems and processes
* Delivery of transformation initiatives and operational IT services across multiple global sites


**The Role**
 The Technical Product Manager – PLM is responsible for defining, owning, and evolving technical products within the RDD IT landscape, with a particular focus on the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) stack.
   

  

 Operating within the RDD IT function, this role ensures that PLM product roadmaps are aligned to engineering needs and business priorities, translating complex requirements into structured plans for delivery. You will act as a key interface between engineering stakeholders, solution architects, and delivery teams, ensuring that solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned to industry best practices.
   

  

 You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to oversee the quality of delivery, drive continuous improvement across product and application lifecycles, and contribute to the long\-term evolution of Dyson’s engineering technology landscape.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities**
 Product Strategy \& Roadmap
   

  

* Create and maintain an IT product development roadmap for PLM (Teamcenter) capabilities
* Ensure roadmaps reflect technical thought leadership and industry best practices
* Align product direction to engineering requirements and business priorities
* Continuously review and refine roadmap based on stakeholder input and delivery outcomes


 Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership
   

  

* Act as an ambassador for Global IT across RDD and NPI stakeholder groups
* Engage with senior RDD stakeholders, engineers, solution architects, and business process owners
* Build strong working relationships across delivery, support, and engineering teams
* Ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and product direction


 Delivery Oversight \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Work within the RDD IT delivery function to oversee quality of technical delivery
* Ensure solutions comply with defined standards, policies, and architectural direction
* Collaborate with delivery teams and external partners to ensure successful execution
* Support resolution of delivery challenges and ensure continuous improvement


 Platform Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Take joint accountability for the robustness and maturity of PLM platforms
* Support and improve product management and application delivery practices
* Identify opportunities to enhance system capabilities and user experience
* Drive continuous improvement across product lifecycle and service delivery


 Vendor \& Partner Management
   

  

* Work with external strategic partners to bring industry insight and best practice

* Support development of long\-term platform capability and vendor strategy


 Technology Strategy \& Innovation
   

  

* Support architecture teams and strategic partners in shaping future platform direction
* Contribute to adoption of new technologies and industry trends within RDD IT
* Identify opportunities to improve capability through innovation and tooling evolution


 Professional Development
   

  

* Own and drive personal and professional development in line with Dyson frameworks
* Use internal development tools to assess capability and define growth objectives
* Continuously build technical and stakeholder management expertise


**Person Specification / Core Competencies**
 You must possess strong technical product management capability, with the ability to bridge engineering needs and IT delivery. You will demonstrate strong organisational skills, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to manage complexity in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
   

  

 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong product management capability within technical or engineering environments
* Ability to translate complex requirements into structured product roadmaps
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to prioritise and manage competing demands at pace
* Strong organisational and delivery focus


**Essential**
* Experience managing technical products within engineering or R\&D environments

* Experience working across delivery teams, architects, and business stakeholders
* Experience contributing to technical strategy and product direction


 Desirable
   

  

* Experience working within global, matrixed organisations

**Overview**
 Emmes Group: Building a better future for us all.
   

  

 Emmes Group is transforming the future of clinical research, bringing the promise of new medical discovery closer within reach for patients. Emmes Group was founded as Emmes more than 47 years ago, becoming one of the primary clinical research providers to the US government before expanding into public\-private partnerships and commercial biopharma. Emmes has built industry leading capabilities in cell and gene therapy, vaccines and infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience.
   

  

 We believe the work we do will have a direct impact on patients’ lives and act accordingly. We strive to build a collaborative culture at the intersection of being a performance and people driven company. We’re looking for talented professionals eager to help advance clinical research as we work to embed innovation into the fabric of our company. If you share our motivations and passion in research, come join us!
   

  

**Primary Purpose**
 The Product Owner is responsible for defining and prioritizing the product backlog and ensuring the delivery of product increments that meet the desired outcomes. They collaborate closely with the development team and stakeholders to ensure alignment with business goals. The Product Owner supports the implementation of strategic objectives set by Software Development leaders and plays a key role in maximizing the product's value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and prioritize the product backlog based on stakeholder feedback, business value, and strategic goals.
* Develop detailed user stories and acceptance criteria for product requirements, ensuring clarity and completeness to guide the development team in creating valuable features that meet end\-user needs.
* Collaborate proactively with the development team to ensure a shared understanding and alignment of product goals and requirements. Act as the voice of the customer, providing insights and guidance to the team throughout the development process.
* Plan and manage product increments and releases strategically, balancing team capacity, technical dependencies, and business priorities to deliver maximum value within set timelines.
* Facilitate product demos and reviews with internal and external stakeholders.
* Actively participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives. Use these meetings to foster communication, identify challenges, and drive continuous improvement within the team.
* Provide clear, actionable guidance and clarification on product requirements to the development team, ensuring that all team members understand the 'why' behind each feature and how it contributes to the overall product vision.
* Act as a liaison between stakeholders and the development team to ensure effective communication and collaboration.
* Assist with secondary tasks such as communication, advertising, and the development of training materials and/or user guides as needed.
* Evangelize the product within and outside the organization.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a public health, clinical, science, technology, or related discipline.
* Incumbent typically will possess at least 5 years of experience working as part of a software development or implementation team in any role, 2 of which must be as a product manager or equivalent role. Years of experience requirements are not cumulative.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Experience with data reporting and analytics.
* Knowledge of key concepts related to software product management is required.
* Supervisory experience over other Product Managers is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive and detail oriented.
* Experience working in a Scrum team is preferred.
* CSPO and/or CSM certification is preferred.
* Experience with drawing tools and UX design is preferred.
* Experience working in a clinical research or health care domain is preferred.
* Experience conducting software demos and marketing presentations is preferred.
* A degree in public health, science, or computer related field is preferred.
* Working knowledge of browser debugging tools is preferred.

jobs.description:
**About CodeRabbit**
 CodeRabbit is an innovative research and development company focused on building extraordinarily productive human\-machine collaboration systems. Our primary goal is to create the next generation of Gen AI\-driven code reviewers: a symbiotic partnership between humans and advanced algorithms that significantly outperforms individual engineers. We combine language models with human ingenuity to push the boundaries of software development efficiency and quality.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring a strong, hands\-on Product Manager to own the application side of the CodeRabbit Management Console, the surfaces every customer touches to set up, configure, control access to, and pay for CodeRabbit. This is a high\-ownership IC role with a clear path to build and lead a team once you've settled in and proven impact.
   

  

 You'll own organization settings, review configuration, role\-based access control, billing and subscriptions, and the onboarding experience. Getting these right is foundational to our move upmarket and to our growth.
   

  

 This isn't an AI\-glamour role. It's a complex, technically demanding, and deeply important one. We want someone who sees that clearly and is excited by it, not someone chasing the next shiny AI feature.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
**Console, Settings \& Configuration**
* Own the end\-to\-end product experience for organization\-level settings, team management, and review configuration
* Make complex configuration understandable and accessible for both technical admins and non\-technical buyers, without dumbing it down
* Work closely with engineering to define APIs, UI flows, and data models for configuration that scale across teams, repos, and deployment types


**Access Control: RBAC \& Custom Roles**
* Own the permission model end to end: define the roles, scopes, and capabilities that govern who can see and do what across settings, configuration, billing, and member management
* Ship custom roles so admins can define their own permission sets rather than being boxed into our defaults, the table\-stakes capability that unblocks larger, more security\-conscious buyers
* Get permission granularity and scoping right: org\-level vs. team\-level vs. repo\-level access, and the inheritance and override behavior between them
* Own audit logs and access trails, who changed what and when, as both an enterprise requirement and a pillar of our security and compliance posture
* Treat least\-privilege defaults, clear permission surfaces, and "no surprises" access behavior as core to the design, not afterthoughts


**Billing \& Subscription Management**
* Own the billing product: pricing display, plan management, seat\-based licensing, upgrades and downgrades, and invoicing
* Reduce friction in the purchase and upgrade path; design self\-serve flows with correct proration, and partner with Growth and Sales on conversion and expansion
* Own plan entitlements and feature gating, the mapping between what someone pays for and what they can actually use, kept consistent across the whole app
* Handle the subscription lifecycle edge cases that quietly break trust: seat reconciliation and true\-ups, renewals, failed payments and dunning, downgrades, and mid\-cycle changes
* Support enterprise purchasing: annual contracts, PO\-based and offline billing, tax and invoicing requirements
* Partner with Finance and Engineering on lifecycle correctness, and own the relationship with our billing infrastructure (Stripe, Chargebee, or similar)


**Onboarding \& Activation**
* Own the onboarding wizard and first\-run experience for new organizations and individual users
* Drive activation metrics: time\-to\-first\-review, time\-to\-team\-invite, and setup completion rates
* Identify and eliminate the top drop\-off points in the setup funnel


**Who You Are**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company
* Technically fluent. You can read code, understand APIs, and have detailed conversations with engineers without a translator
* Track record of owning complex, multi\-stakeholder product areas such as admin consoles, permissions/RBAC systems, or billing systems, where correctness and edge cases matter as much as the happy path
* Strong instincts for simplifying complex configuration and access experiences without dumbing them down
* Comfortable with ambiguity; can move from fuzzy problem to clear spec without hand\-holding
* You write well and communicate precisely. PRDs and tickets you've written are things you're proud of
* Low ego, high ownership. You care about the outcome more than the credit


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience at a developer tooling, DevOps, or code intelligence company
* Direct experience with RBAC, permissions, or identity/access systems, designing role models, scopes, and audit logging
* Experience with billing infrastructure (Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and subscription lifecycle mechanics
* Familiarity with multi\-tenant SaaS architectures, and with audit/compliance requirements (SOC 2 and similar)
* Working knowledge of Git platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, ADO) as a power user or PM
* You've worked with or alongside a small, high\-output engineering team and know how to match their pace


**What This Isn't**
 We'll be upfront: this role isn't primarily about building AI features. If what excites you most is prompt engineering, model evaluation, or shipping AI\-native UX, this probably isn't your best fit right now.
   

  

 What it is: one of the most important, highest\-leverage product bets we're making. The companies that win in developer tooling are the ones who nail the unglamorous stuff, setup, configuration, access control, billing, and trust. We need someone who genuinely believes that.
